# Statusline

> Statusline is an independent open-source companion for viewing Codex quota and reset times on desktop, mobile apps and widgets.

The desktop companion reads usage metadata from the local Codex session. Optional
mobile synchronization uses end-to-end encrypted quota snapshots. Statusline is
not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by OpenAI.

## Website

- [Statusline — English](https://statusline.inmerzion.io/): Project overview, features and download links.
- [Statusline — Español](https://statusline.inmerzion.io/es/): Project overview in Spanish.

## Project and documentation

- [iPhone app](https://apps.apple.com/app/statusline/id6807851320): Free on the App Store for iPhone with iOS 17 or later. Native app and home screen widgets.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/arvivares/statusline): Source code and project overview.
- [Releases](https://github.com/arvivares/statusline/releases): Published downloads and release notes.
- [Documentation index](https://github.com/arvivares/statusline/blob/main/docs/README.md): Architecture, operations, release and security documentation.
- [Setup guide](https://github.com/arvivares/statusline/blob/main/SETUP.md): Installation and configuration instructions in Spanish.
- [MIT license](https://github.com/arvivares/statusline/blob/main/LICENSE): License terms for the project.

Android is in beta, with APKs available on GitHub Releases. Public Google Play
availability is coming soon.

## Support and privacy

- [Support](https://statusline-relay.inmerzion.workers.dev/support): Public support information.
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/arvivares/statusline/blob/main/SUPPORT.md): Installation, pairing and usage troubleshooting.
- [Privacy policy](https://statusline-relay.inmerzion.workers.dev/privacy): Data handling, encrypted synchronization and retention.
